title: Here are all the new Animoji coming to your iPhone X (AAPL)
text: Here are all the new Animoji coming to your iPhone X (AAPL) Avery Hartmans Justin Sullivan/Getty Apple unveiled its upcoming iPhone software, iOS 11.3, on Wednesday. The update, which arrives sometime this spring, includes four new Animoji: lion, dragon, skull, and bear. The new Animoji are only available on iPhone X. New Animoji are coming to the iPhone X. On Wednesday, Apple unveiled a few new features of its upcoming software for iPhones and iPads, iOS 11.3, which will arrive sometime this spring. The update includes new AR capabilities, more information about your phone's battery, a new health records feature, and four new Animoji. Animoji, which are only available on the iPhone X, are animated emoji that can mimic your facial expressions thanks to the sensors and front-facing camera on Apple's latest iPhone. Apple included a slew of Animoji when the iPhone X launched — including a cat, dog, chicken, and pig — but this is the first time it's announcing new options since the phone was unveiled in September. The new Animoji include a skull, dragon, bear, and lion. Here's what they'll look like: New Animoji
